notes.title: Diorama Mode Has Arrived! ✨
notes.notes:
[b]We’re excited to introduce the Diorama Mode update to Teeny Tiny Town! [/b]

Based on your feedback, we understand that Endless Play Mode isn’t for everyone. So, we’ve created a more structured way to enjoy the game! In Diorama Mode, you’ll progress through levels to unlock and craft beautiful dioramas, adding a creative and goal-driven twist to the gameplay you already love.

What's in the update:

[b]🏙️ New Diorama Campaign Mode:[/b]

In this new mode, you’ll unlock increasingly intricate pieces for your dioramas, progressing through levels that challenge your puzzle-solving skills while giving you the chance to craft unique and beautiful mini-worlds. It’s a whole new way to experience the game with an added focus on creativity and completion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838323/e4d14ec881ac3553ba40280a9f95df33c160db1d.jpg[/img]

[b]⚡ New Power-Up: Instant Upgrade[/b]

Take your strategy to the next level! Instantly advance items on the board to open up fresh possibilities and create even more satisfying combos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838323/c0339dcde9195321f6fd6215d8ff8316b2d312f8.jpg[/img]

[b]📚 Updated Tutorial[/b]

Thanks to your valuable feedback, we’ve revamped the tutorial to make it clearer and more helpful for all players, whether you’re just starting out or refining your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838323/67bf62715b579c7aeae0babb375648a641e612e8.jpg[/img]

Let us know what you think! 

Short Cicuit team 💌

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Live Stream 🧩
notes.notes:
In celebration of our Steam Next Fest participation, we’re thrilled to stream Teeny Tiny Town demo right on our store page! 

Merge tiles to build your dream city, one tiny step at a time. It's like magic, but with strategy. 🌟 Chill out with lo-fi beats and enjoy the charming low-poly art. Night mode? We've got that too for all the dark mode lovers. No rush here—just relax and build at your own pace. 🏙️✨ 

We'll also be answering all your questions about the game.

Stream starts: 06/11/2024 at 4:00 PM BST / 5:00 PM CET / 8:00 AM PT

See you there!

notes.title: Brand New Trailer!
notes.notes:
Hello, Teeny Tiny Town citizens!

We're thrilled to share our [b]brand-new trailer[/b] with all of you, designed to give you a deeper look into the captivating world we've built. This isn't just any update; it's your window into the vast experiences awaiting in Teeny Tiny Town, showcasing the beautiful themes and diverse maps you'll explore in the full release.

Our current demo has offered a glimpse into the serene and relaxing gameplay that defines Teeny Tiny Town, but believe us when we say it's just the tip of the iceberg. The full game expands on this foundation with more themes, more maps, and more opportunities for creativity and relaxation.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715700/Teeny_Tiny_Town]Check out the new trailer now[/url] to [b]get a sneak peak and see what lies beyond the demo[/b] 🏙️👀

notes.title: Demo-lition Day in Teeny Tiny Town
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that the much-anticipated demo of Teeny Tiny Town is now live!

What's Inside the Demo?

🏘️ Dive into the enchanting world of Teeny Tiny Town with our original theme!
🗺️ Explore 2 unique maps and enjoy unlimited playtime!

We're eager to hear what you think! Your feedback is invaluable to us. Feel free to share your thoughts right here on Steam or join the conversation in our Discord community. Happy gaming!
